tagline: Out over the bay, steered by a single palm.
intro: Manatee Avenue leaves the mainland at 75th Street West and heads out over the water, crossing Palma Sola Bay on a causeway built in 1957, then Perico Island and a drawbridge over Anna Maria Sound, and ends at East Bay Drive on Anna Maria Island.

Palma Sola means solitary palm. The palm is an old one near the beach at Holmes Beach, and for many years sailors searched the horizon for it to find their way into Anna Maria Sound and Palma Sola Bay.

moments.title: Palma Sola Causeway
moments.text: The causeway is kept like a long park, with picnic areas among native plantings, and people fish, sail and water-ski off it along its whole length.

moments.title: Anna Maria Island Bridge
moments.text: Before this double-leaf drawbridge opened in 1957, the one bridge from the mainland was the Cortez Bridge, and until 1921 the island could be reached only by boat.

moments.title: Holmes Beach
moments.text: Esther Williams was filming On an Island with You here in 1948, two years before the town voted 46 to 13 to incorporate.
